app.name: Webview Tracking
app.short_description: Follow webview sends and journeys (catalog, exchange/return and tracking).
app.long_description: Dashboard for the webviews sent in conversations: sends, clicks, completions, agent requests, errors and exchange/return and catalog reports.
app.installation_instructions: Enter the server address (api_host) and the access secret (api_secret), then click Install.

api_host.label: Server address (api_host)
api_host.helpText: https address of the tracking server, without a trailing slash.

api_secret.label: Access secret (api_secret)
api_secret.helpText: Tracking API secret. It is stored securely and never reaches the browser.

demo_mode.label: Demo mode
demo_mode.helpText: Shows fictional data without querying the server.

errors.waking: Waking up the server, this can take up to 1 minute
errors.unauthorized: Access denied. Check the secret (api_secret) in the app settings.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.unavailable: The server is unavailable right now. Try again shortly.
errors.config: Invalid configuration. Check the api_host (https address) in the app settings.
errors.bad_request: This query could not be made.

diag.title: What happened

active_request.title: There is already a request in progress
active_request.guidance: Not an error. Follow the existing request or contact customer service.

marketplace.title: Marketplace purchase
marketplace.guidance: Tell the customer to use the exchange center of the marketplace where they bought.

order_situation.title: The order status does not allow an exchange
order_situation.guidance: Check the order status before advising the customer.

deadline.title: Exchange period is over
deadline.guidance: Tell the customer about the deadline.

no_reasons.title: No exchange or return option
no_reasons.guidance: Check whether the other type (exchange or return) is available.

not_eligible.title: Order not eligible
not_eligible.guidance: Check the Troque message before advising the customer.

order_not_found.title: Order not found
order_not_found.guidance: Confirm the order number and the CPF or e-mail with the customer.

session_expired.title: Session expired
session_expired.guidance: Send the customer a new button.

creation_unconfirmed.title: Creation not confirmed
creation_unconfirmed.guidance: Check whether the request was created before asking to try again.

integration.title: Troque failure
integration.guidance: Ask to try again. If it repeats, contact IT.

screen_error.title: Error shown to the customer
screen_error.guidance: Ask to try again. If it repeats, contact IT.

handoff.title: Customer sent to an agent
handoff.guidance: Continue the service in the conversation.

unknown.title: Ended with an error without detail
unknown.guidance: Ask to try again. If it repeats, contact IT.

ineligibility.alreadyHaveActiveExchangeRequest: There is already an active exchange request for the order
ineligibility.contactSAC: Tell the customer to contact customer service
ineligibility.orderUnauthorizedSituation: The order status does not allow exchange or return

vtex.title: VTEX order
vtex.unverified: Order found by the number typed by the customer, which Troque did not confirm. It may not belong to this customer: check before sharing.

reasons.no_order_number: There is no order number to look up.
reasons.not_found: VTEX found no order with this number.
reasons.not_configured: VTEX lookup is not configured for this brand.
reasons.forbidden: The VTEX key is not allowed to read orders. Contact IT.
reasons.unavailable: VTEX did not answer. Try again shortly.
reasons.route_missing: VTEX lookup is not available on the server yet.
